newsitem.title: USA: Advanced Fibre sets terms of IPO at $56 mln.
newsitem.headline: Advanced Fibre sets terms of IPO at $56 mln.

text.p: Advanced Fibre Communications Inc has proposed terms for its upcoming initial public offering to be underwritten by Morgan Stanley & Co.

In a filing Monday with the U.S. Securities and Exchange Commission, the company has proposed to offer 3.5 million share in an estimated range of $15 to $17 a share. At the midpoint of the range, the deal would be worth $56 million.

Advanced Fibre has developed a system that allows phone and cable companies to connect their subscribers to a central office switch over copper, fiberoptic, or other wires. It would sell all the shares in the offering.
The company has proposed to trade on the Nasdaq under the symbol AFCI.O.
